citeAs: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert (2020). MLS: A LARGE-SCALE MULTILINGUAL DATASET FOR SPEECH RESEARCH.
creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert (Facebook AI Research)
description: A large multilingual corpus suitable for speech research derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox, consisting of 8 languages.
inLanguage: en, de, nl, es, fr, pt, it, pl
name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
rai:dataCollection: Derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox. Audio is segmented into 10-20 second segments. Pseudo labels are generated using acoustic models, and original transcripts are retrieved by matching pseudo-labels to available book transcripts.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Read audiobooks from LibriVox and text data from Project Gutenberg and other online sources.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio downsampled from 48kHz to 16kHz. Audio segmented into 10-20 second segments. Text normalization: NFKC normalization, removal of unwanted characters, hyphens, and filtering valid unicode characters. Numbers replaced with aligned words from pseudo labels.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Acoustic models using Time-Depth Separable (TDS) Convolutions with Auto-Segmentation Criterion (ASG) loss for audio segmentation. 4-gram language model for pseudo label generation. SVM with RBF kernel for gender classification.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Gender of speakers is labeled using a classifier.

null_reasons.rai:annotationsPerItem: No manual annotations per item; labels are retrieved from existing transcripts.
null_reasons.rai:dataBiases: No explicit discussion of data biases.
null_reasons.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: No discussion of missing data handling during collection.
null_reasons.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: No specific timeframe for data collection mentioned.
null_reasons.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: No data manipulation protocol described for the dataset itself.
